policy.name: MINIMAL_MEMORY_INGESTION_POLICY v1.0.0
policy.scope: Applies ONLY to memory ingestion: External Conversation Space writes, Snapshot generation, Attach Packet creation, phase ledger entries, risk ledger entries, decision ledger entries. Does NOT apply to normal user-facing answers.
principles: Normal answers remain detailed and helpful — Minimal Mode is ingestion-only
Memory records must be self-contained with evidence path and caveat
No overclaim: design ≠ execution, local ≠ production, observation ≠ proof
No stale: retired claims, resolved blockers, outdated recommendations must carry RETIRED marker
No contamination: secret values, production endpoints, real project data excluded

rules.rule: Every memory record must include evidence_path pointing to source artifact
Every memory record must include caveat if claim is partial, conditional, or design-only
Memory record body ≤ 500 chars; longer content → reference to full report
Design analysis must be tagged DESIGN_ONLY; never presented as execution evidence
Local trial results must be tagged LOCAL_ONLY; never presented as production readiness
Retired/outdated claims must carry RETIRED marker with retirement reason
No secret values, production endpoints, or real project data in any memory record
